title: fix(plugin-detail): the record page names the owner once when a details section draws owner_id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_
Fixes #35941
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (no file under `skills/**` names the record page's owner meta line; `skills/**` is not edited)

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv

Implements the maintainer ruling recorded on the card in comment 7056427422 (option A, 「底部行不再显示」): when a field group on the record page renders `owner_id`, the bottom meta line leaves the owner out; when no group renders it, the meta line shows the owner as before; the body's groups stay as declared. The facts are the seat's correction, comment 7053437630.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在默认记录页上,详情正文的某个分组已经显示负责人时,底部信息行不再重复显示负责人,负责人只出现一次,就在正文里可以修改的那一格。
- 为什么做:属于记录页重做这个大项,解决负责人在页面上出现两次的问题(之前的去重只看关键字段条,默认页已不再画那一条)。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某页负责人一处都不显示或仍显示两次,只影响显示,不改数据,可以直接撤回这次改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- **The body reports what it draws.** A new module-internal registry, `recordBodyFields.ts` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, collects the field rows the page's details sections actually mount. `DetailSection` reports its laid-out rows while its content is mounted (the frameless face and the card disclosure mount it only open; the non-collapsible card always does), and only when it draws the page's own record (`RecordPageProvenanceContext`, the context `record:details` already sets when it carries no data binding). So a field the reader may not read, a field or group hidden by `visibleWhen`, a `hidden` field, or a collapsed section reports nothing, and a section drawn for another record (a bound `record:details`, a drawer portalled from a related list) reports nothing either.
- **The meta line reads it.** `RecordMetaFooter` leaves the owner out when the strip draws `owner_id` (unchanged) OR the body registry holds `owner_id`. Outside a registry it reads `null` and keeps the strip-only rule.
- **The laid-out page mounts it.** `RecordPageColumns` creates the registry and provides it around the details column and the meta line that closes it.
- The answer comes from the rows the body mounts, not from a second derivation of the sections: the declared group, the "Other" bucket (`deriveFieldGroupLayout`'s keyless trailing bucket) and the auto split all resolve to whatever `record:details` actually draws.
- No prop, export or locale key is added; `RecordDetailView.tsx` is not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **One mount is not covered: the footer a default page draws below its tab strip when the strip cannot be laid out** (`RecordDetailView`'s `!pageColumns` branch). That footer and the body are siblings in the host, so the registry would have to be mounted by `RecordDetailView`, which means a new export from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (a widening, Clause-② yes). On that branch the footer keeps the strip-only rule. The seat ruled (2026-11-21, option A) that this PR leaves it and no card is filed: the branch is rare (a default page whose tab strip cannot be laid out), and covering it would widen `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s public surface and touch `RecordDetailView.tsx` while two open PRs edit it.
- A collapsed group holding `owner_id` keeps the owner on the meta line; when the reader opens the group, the owner moves into the group and leaves the meta line (pinned).
- `RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnce-28868.test.tsx` and `RecordMetaFooter.drawnStrip-28909.test.tsx` pass unchanged. Neither pins a rule this change supersedes: both render the footer with no registry, where the strip-only rule still holds.
- **One pin is superseded and rewritten: `RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909.test.tsx`.** It pinned "on a phone / on a desktop: no strip, and the meta line names the owner". It mounts a real `RecordDetailView` whose lead declares no field groups, so `owner_id` lands in the auto-derived section and the body draws it. Under the maintainer ruling in card comment 7056427422 (option A, 「底部行不再显示」), the owner is then that body field and the meta line leaves it out. On c8171460 the old pin failed at both widths (the owner entry was missing from the meta line). CI Test UI 9/16 caught it, and a local control run reproduced it: Tests 2 failed (2), at the `expect(owner).toBeTruthy()` line. The rewrite keeps #28909's intent, that the owner is on the page once at every width. At 390 px and at 1440 px it now pins the following. When the body draws `owner_id`, the owner's name is painted exactly once on the page and the meta line has no owner entry. A lead whose `owner_id` is `hidden`, so the body draws none, keeps the owner on the meta line, also painted once. In both cases the rest of the meta line (the record id) is still drawn. The file's header names the superseded pin and the ruling.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnceBody-35941.test.tsx`. It composes the default page as `RecordDetailView` does (`deriveRecordDetailSections` → `buildDefaultPageSchema` → `buildDefaultPageColumns` → `RecordPageColumns` with the real `record:details` block and `RecordMetaFooter`) and counts the owner's name over the whole page:

- a declared group holding `owner_id`: painted once, in the body, footer without owner;
- no declared groups (auto-derived section): once;
- declared groups that leave `owner_id` out (it lands in "Other"): once;
- groups that leave `owner_id` out and it is drawn nowhere (`hidden: true`): the owner is on the meta line, once;
- a collapsed group holding `owner_id`: on the meta line, then in the body once the group opens, once each time.

<details><summary>Readings (head c8171460; the new file and the 28868 / 28909 footer files re-run on this tree: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 17 passed)</summary>

- New file: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 5 passed (5).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: Test Files 394 passed, 1 skipped (395); Tests 3626 passed, 18 skipped.
- `RecordDetailView.oneProvenanceFooter-12307` with the new file: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 8 passed (8).
- Ablation 1, the meta line's body check replaced with `false` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed anchor 1 → 0, restored blob == HEAD): Tests 4 failed, 1 passed; the four body-draws cases went red and the hidden-owner control stayed green.
- Ablation 2, the section's collapse condition replaced with `true`: Tests 1 failed, 4 passed; only the collapsed-group case went red.
- Both ablations run against `src` (the ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/plugin-detail` to its source), so no `dist` rebuild was involved.
- Fix round 1 (head a61e3b2d): the rewritten `RecordDetailView.phoneOwnerLine-28909` file gave Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 4 passed (4). The same file at c8171460 (control) gave Tests 2 failed (2). Every app-shell `RecordDetailView*` suite plus every test that asserts the owner or the meta line (`recordPageV3Face-27055`, `RecordMetaFooter.drawnStrip-28909`, `RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnce-28868`, `DetailView.title2688`, `detailPage.emptinessAuthority-8394`, `record-details.pageProvenance-12307`, `ObjectView.recordDrawer-27545`, `AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999`, the new 35941 file) gave Test Files 106 passed (106), Tests 820 passed (820).

</details>

## Verification

Read first: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` (the `drawsContent` condition must match the render branches below it), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordBodyFields.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordMetaFooter.ownerOnceBody-35941.test.tsx` → 5 passed. In the Console, open a record of an object with an owner on the default page: the owner shows in the details body and no "Owner" entry is on the meta line at the foot of the details column.

**Browser reading** (head a61e3b2d; Chromium via Playwright, deviceScaleFactor 2, at 1280 and 375 wide). The stack was the showcase app: a `--fresh` backend, plus the Console served by Vite from this tree's `ui/` source. The record is a `showcase_contact` named "Grace Hopper", created through the REST API and owned by Dev Admin. The metadata edits were temporary and uncommitted; afterwards the file was restored from HEAD (blob equal to HEAD, `git status` clean).

- (a) The object gained an `Ownership` group listing `owner_id`. Result: one Owner row, in that group, and no owner on the meta line. Files: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/a-group-open-1280.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/a-group-open-375.png`.
- (b) `owner_id` was declared `hidden` and placed in no group. Result: no Owner row in the body, and "Owner Dev Admin" on the meta line. Files: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/b-hidden-open-1280.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/b-hidden-open-375.png`.
- Collapsed `Ownership` group. While collapsed, the owner is on the meta line. After the group is expanded, the Owner row is in the group and the meta line has no owner. Files: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/c-collapsed-collapsed-1280.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/c-collapsed-expanded-1280.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/c-collapsed-collapsed-375.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/c-collapsed-expanded-375.png`.
- Stock showcase, with no edit: `owner_id` lands in the "Other" group. Result: one Owner row there, and no owner on the meta line. Files: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/d-stock-other-open-1280.png`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35941/d-stock-other-open-375.png`.
- A sampler ran on every animation frame from the moment the meta line mounted. It counted Owner rows in the body plus the meta line's owner entry, about 160 frames per load and about 60 after each expand. No sampled frame showed the owner twice or missing from both places, in any run.
